_notes: Local CI targets for Nabih's Portfolio (app/scripts/ci-runner.ts).

piggymetrics is Spring Boot 2.0.3 (Java 8 era), so it runs on a Maven image with Java 11. Only the service modules with tests are built; their Spring tests start an embedded MongoDB, which downloads a mongod binary on first run.
juice-shop is scanned through GitHub only (no clone), so it has no local CI target.

targets.name: maven
targets.run: (mvn -B -ntp -fae test -pl account-service,auth-service,statistics-service,notification-service,gateway -am 2>&1 | tee /out/mvn.log; echo "mvn exit $?") && find . -path '*/surefire-reports/TEST-*.xml' -exec cp {} /out/ \;
targets.note: account, auth, statistics, notification and gateway modules
